race.comment: ROCK ANGEL (5) is the horse to beat after putting his maiden away here in style when heavily supported. Doesn't waste any time trying to make it two on the bounce and can do just that. GATHERS NO STONE (4) showed positive signs in Victoria but was patchy. Has trialled well here in readiness and deserves respect in the new colours. EMINEN (11) is fit and reliable, coming off a narrow second at this track after winning at Emerald. Gets weight relief to help offset the class rise. Not dismissing. LA NARRADORA (7) drops back slightly in trip off a 42-day freshen and keeps a 2kg claimer to get her in well at the weights. Just needs to hold her form to be competitive.
